content.short: Treasury/accounts platform for fiat, crypto and stablecoin business flows.
content.description: Nilos is a business treasury and payments platform that unifies fiat, crypto, and stablecoin flows for companies operating across borders, especially into emerging markets. From one place, businesses can connect crypto wallets, bank accounts, and payment service providers to collect, hold, exchange, and pay using stablecoins such as USDC and USDT over networks like Ethereum, Polygon, and Tron alongside traditional currencies. Nilos handles treasury operations end to end — tracking incoming payments, reconciling money flows across crypto and fiat, and executing global payouts — so finance teams can manage everything from a single dashboard. Backed by venture funding, it targets internationally active companies that want the speed and reach of stablecoins with proper accounting, reconciliation, and compliance built in.
content.meta: Nilos unifies fiat, crypto, and stablecoin treasury and payments for businesses. Discover Nilos and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
